ledger: Young boy | Blue zip-up jacket, short brown hair | Same as start | Hand positions and movements change abruptly across multiple cuts.

findings.description: Before the cut, the boy's left hand rests on the rim of the glass bowl. After the cut, it instantly teleports to an elevated position above the bowl, holding a ball alongside his right hand.
Before the cut, the boy's right hand is resting on the right side of the bowl's rim. After the cut, it instantly appears in mid-air above the center of the bowl.
Before the cut, the boy's right hand is moving slowly inside the bowl. After the cut, it instantly transitions to a very rapid, blurred swirling motion without any time for acceleration.
